claim: Best observed validation full-run win rate for this completed 30-by-42 checkpoint screen

reward.note: Descriptive on natural endings only; no undefined reward imputation.

remaining_hp.source: last battle hp_terminal/max_hp_terminal, when the last battle is closed
remaining_hp.note: The raw run-level hp field is zero on victories after run completion; reported_run_hp preserves that value but is not a meaningful victory-HP measure. Limit endings have null last-battle terminal HP.

caveats: Selected maximum among 1260 pairings on reused validation seeds; selection can inflate observed performance.
Not an independent held-out test estimate or native-game win-rate claim.
Cross-host action parity was not tested for this evaluation; native reference-game replay count is zero.
Four 100-turn combat-limit outcomes are included as non-wins in the 256-run denominator.

verification.method: Read-only recomputation from original per-run outcomes, admission ledger, exact seed manifest, completed study CSV and source checkpoint bytes; no gameplay or model evaluation.
verification.seed_join: 256 unique planned = 256 unique admitted = 256 unique observed seeds; matching run IDs between admissions and outcomes.
